report.summary: Consolidated round2 verifications: 3 CONFIRMED findings from v-memstore lead to 4 actions ranked by blast radius. 1 UNDECIDABLE from v-memstore and 7 from v-cheap-fitness are listed as risks. No disagreements detected.

risks.description: UNDECIDABLE: verify_ledger function body absent; full tamper-evidence guarantee cannot be confirmed.
UNDECIDABLE: Coverage-based heuristics assume tests covering changed code are most relevant; may not hold for all bugs.
UNDECIDABLE: Test suite reduction may miss failures in excluded tests, leading to false positives.
UNDECIDABLE: Learned surrogates require training data and may overfit.
UNDECIDABLE: Measure correlation between reduced suite verdict and full suite verdict on your benchmark.
UNDECIDABLE: Implement random subset test suite reduction (e.g., 10% of tests) as cheap fitness signal.
UNDECIDABLE: Consider static analysis warnings as auxiliary signal, but do not rely on them alone.
UNDECIDABLE: Compare with coverage-based reduction (only tests covering changed lines).

todos.action: Implement verify_ledger function with full tamper-evidence checking.
Add cross-process file locking (e.g., portalocker) around ledger append to prevent write interleaving.
In _normalize_entry, validate trust sub-dict keys and reject unknown ones to be consistent with other sub-dict validation.
In _ends_without_newline, avoid opening for reading while another process may be appending; use os.lseek on append handle or handle exception.

handoff.suggestion: Provide cheap-fitness.py to resolve undecidable claims; implement confirmed memstore.py fixes in priority order.
